Runs recorded before this baseline are comparable to runs after it only when they name their preset. The simulation digest was produced independently on windows-x86_64 and on linux-aarch64 before it was committed. Regenerated 2026-09-08 for the era boundary that made pt-v18 the default preset at 0.7.0: every seeded trajectory changed, deliberately. Runs recorded before this baseline are comparable to runs after it only when they name their preset. metadataSha256 did NOT move at this boundary and that is not an omission: model_preset() reports the mispricing and crowd coefficients, and pt-v16 and pt-v18 carry identical values for every one of them, so the reported vector is unchanged while the simulated one is not. The simulation digest moved a second time before 0.7.0 shipped: this file's engine section passes an explicit macro state, and a supplied opening is no longer relaxed by macro_burn_in_days -- an engine asked for a VIX of 45.0 opened at 21.55 until that was fixed.
